339-677-1879-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-1879-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3318-5671.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-5671.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4591-6734-8089.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

5060-5078-6666.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
5060-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1409-2079-3099-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-5711-7730.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

478-1399-6071-7775.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five permanent cards in your graveyard.
478-1399-6071-7775.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping The Core and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Formidable Speaker.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Repeat.

3967-6258--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

4499-6633-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

1722-2034-4893-6441-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-4893-6441-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

4742-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
4742-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-4481-5007.description:
Activate Morselhoarder by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate Morselhoarder by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5147-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1659-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2607-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2607-5944.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Unstoppable Slasher
Unstoppable Slasher triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
The opponent dealt combat damage loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1003-2099-2173-5220.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1238-2351-2957-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken until end of turn.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

81-3464-3657.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
81-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

5414-5478-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5414-5478-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

198-2609-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {W} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

1920-2060-4222-5328-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-4222-5328-5902.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

1283-1939-2034-3613.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Luminous Phantom.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Luminous Phantom, adding {2}.
Because Dress Down causes Luminous Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.

1950-2335-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Nurturing Presence attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
1950-2335-4702.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate the nontoken Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

328-791-1494-2963.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to black times the number of opponents you have is greater than or equal to 15.
328-791-1494-2963.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Unspeakable Symbol five times by paying 15 life, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2279-2287-3560-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2279-2287-3560-5231.description:
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying {1}{R}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Fiery Mantle enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Pegasus and the creature that Fiery Mantle is attached to, adding {R}{R}.
Fiery Mantle triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

654-3811-4013.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least three nonland cards in their graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn.
654-3811-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wreck Hunter.
Wreck Hunter enters the battlefield, creating at least four tapped Powerstone artifact tokens.
The Powerstones enter the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor that many times, untapping the Powerstones.
Activate three Powerstones by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
654-3811-4013.notes: The opponent must have at least four relevant cards for this combo to produce infinite mana.

283-4474-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Paradise Mantle attached to Morphling.
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
283-4474-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Morphling's ability.
Resolve the copy of Morphling's ability, untapping it.
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
 Resolve Morphling's ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

1558-3888.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia's Attendants does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Olivia's Attendants.
1558-3888.description:
Deal combat damage with Olivia's Attendants.
Olivia's Attendants trggers, creating six Blood tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Blood tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1737-2034-2637-4840-4853.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles.
1737-2034-2637-4840-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mechtitan Core.
Activate the Mechtitan Core token by paying {5} and exiling it, Myr Battlesphere, and any three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles, creating a 10/10 Mechtitan creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Mechtitan token, adding {C}{C}.
The Mechtitan token dies, triggering Dross Scorpion and Mechtitan Core.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Mechtitan Core token trigger, returning all other cards exiled by it to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion triggers three times, allowing you to untap up to three artifacts you control.
Repeat.

4050-4690-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five basic lands.
4050-4690-5140.description:
Cast Phylath.
Phylath triggers, creating a number of Plant creature tokens equal to the number of basic lands you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phylath, adding {B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Plant token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 4 an additional three times.
Activate Kenrith, returning Phylath to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
